$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers for working ON this repo — exploration and diagnosis from
the editor. Deliberately NOT what the autonomous evaluation agent uses: that runs
headless on Vercel Cron against the PostHog REST API and the Neon driver directly, so
it has zero dependency on a desktop session. See docs/4-AI-NATIVE-WORKFLOW.md §5.
Both servers read credentials from the environment via ${VAR} expansion, so no secret
is committed. Values live in .env, which is gitignored.
neon-readonly expects DATABASE_URL_READONLY — a role with SELECT and nothing else.
The write path is the application's; an assistant answering questions about the data
has no business holding UPDATE on the table that controls live ad traffic. Create it
